annotations.title: Token flows pack: who bought, who sold, net flow and price

description: Token flows in one call: USD price, net DEX buy and sell flow in time buckets, the top buyers and sellers, and an OFAC screen of the top three of each, on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. A failed part is listed in `failed`. Use before trading a token, for a trading agent's context, or to watch a launch. Example: token=0x940181a94A35A4569E4529A3CDfB74e38FD98631. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to read, 100 to 10000 (default 1800: about 6 hours on Ethereum); on Base, which makes a block every 0.2 s, ten times that (default 18000, about an hour, up to 100000)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

limit.description: Buyers and sellers to return each, 1 to 10 (default 5)

token.description: Token: 0x ERC-20 address, or a ticker such as AERO, DEGEN or USDC
